faqs.question: What is the difference between TOEFL and IELTS?
faqs.answer: TOEFL is computer-based and uses American English, while IELTS includes a face-to-face speaking test and uses British English. We help you choose the right test based on your goals.

faqs.question: Is TOEFL accepted in India for jobs?
faqs.answer: TOEFL is primarily used for studying abroad, but some Indian institutions and employers also accept it.
